// diagnostic

E3214

Variadic C function `{name}` cannot use `{abi}`.

What

Variadic C function `{name}` cannot use `{abi}`.

Why

Variadics allow only the default C ABI, or `cdecl` on Windows x86 — other calling conventions don't define how a variadic argument list is passed.

Fix

remove `#ABI`, or use `#ABI(cdecl)` on Windows x86.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3214: tests/ui/cffi_abi_variadic_invalid.stderr.

Error [E3214]: variadic C function `log` cannot use `sysv64`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_abi_variadic_invalid.jet:4:10
    |
  4 |     #ABI(sysv64) fn log(fmt: String, args: ...I32) I32 = "log"
    |          ^^^^^^
 Why: variadics allow only the default C ABI, or cdecl on Windows x86
 Fix: remove `#ABI`, or use `#ABI(cdecl)` on Windows x86
